spells.name: Ember
spells.does: Flame strikes a foe in Near or Far.
spells.horrorReason: Casting forbidden magic tempts the Horror, whether the spell succeeds or fails.

spells.name: Kindle
spells.does: Set fire to, or put out, something small. Light to Near. No roll.
spells.horrorReason: Casting forbidden magic tempts the Horror, whether the spell succeeds or fails.

spells.name: Mend
spells.does: Yourself or any target in Close or Near heals Effort d8. Once per person per rest.

spells.name: Ward
spells.does: An ally in Close or Near gets +2 Defence until your next turn.
spells.horrorReason: Casting forbidden magic tempts the Horror, whether the spell succeeds or fails.

spells.name: Unmake
spells.does: A foe in Near or Far takes Effort d10 force, and is left Dazed: its next attack rolls 3 less.
spells.horrorReason: Casting forbidden magic tempts the Horror, whether the spell succeeds or fails.

spells.name: Speak with the Dead
spells.does: Ask a corpse one question. It answers truly, and briefly.
spells.horrorReason: Casting forbidden magic tempts the Horror, whether the spell succeeds or fails.

spells.name: Rend the Veil
spells.does: Once per scene, choose the visible foes within Close or Near that the GM agrees are affected. Make one INT check; on success roll Ultimate Effort d12 once and apply that damage to every selected foe. The attempt spends the scene use and adds 1 Horror, hit or miss. Range and eligible targets are judged by the GM.
spells.horrorReason: Casting forbidden magic tempts the Horror, whether the spell succeeds or fails.

spells.name: Hush
spells.does: One creature's voice is silenced until the end of the scene.
spells.horrorReason: Casting forbidden magic tempts the Horror, whether the spell succeeds or fails.

spells.name: Steal a Word
spells.does: Take the last word a creature spoke. It cannot say that word again until you give it back.
spells.horrorReason: Casting forbidden magic tempts the Horror, whether the spell succeeds or fails.

spells.name: Confession of the Dead
